# Kredit Motor Honda

> Honda Wijaya Abadi Mulia Motor is an authorized Honda motorcycle dealer in Bandung, Indonesia. The website provides a motorcycle catalog, estimated credit simulations, current promotions, and dealer contact details.

Use the catalog for current model names, descriptions, specifications, and listed prices. Credit calculations are estimates; final rates and installments are confirmed by the financing provider.

## Public Pages

- [Homepage](https://kreditmotorhonda.tech/): Dealer information, motorcycle catalog, promotions, credit simulator, customer reviews, and contact details.
- [Motorcycle catalog](https://kreditmotorhonda.tech/#katalog): Browse models, specifications, and listed Bandung OTR prices.
- [Credit simulator](https://kreditmotorhonda.tech/#simulasi): Estimate down payment and monthly installments for a selected motorcycle.
- [Promotions](https://kreditmotorhonda.tech/#promo): Review current Honda offers and their terms.
- [Dealer contact](https://kreditmotorhonda.tech/#kontak): Address, phone, business hours, and map.
